name: Spotify
description: Explore a new way to discover music, podcasts, and audiobooks, with recommendations that are uniquely you. Want music to power your next run, study session, or party? Just ask and Spotify will drop the right songs, artists, or playlists into your conversation. With Spotify in Claude you can: Ask for songs, artists, albums, or playlists and play them in Spotify. Find podcasts and audiobooks that match your interests. Spotify Premium listeners can describe a vibe and get a personalized playlist made to match. Easily see where Spotify is playing and switch devices to keep listening wherever you are.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Spotify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Spotify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-gateway-external-pilot.spotify.net/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Spotify MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Spotify scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Spotify MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Spotify provides these MCP tools: create_playlist, get_currently_playing, search, add_to_library, fetch_tracks, and Remove_from_library.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Spotify?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Spotify in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Spotify does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Why is Spotify failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Spotify scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Spotify is developed by Spotify. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
